name: Hermes (your install)
description: The Hermes Agent you installed yourself, with its own settings, memory and skills.
settings_note: Uses your Hermes model settings. To change the model, run hermes model in a terminal.
install: Install it with: curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash (Windows: iex (irm https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.ps1)), then run hermes acp --setup.
setup: Run hermes acp --setup in a terminal.
